craft_notes: Sthāyin: raudra-vīra of the cremation ground — Rauhine register throughout: broken-middle-drunk → gore teaches → brow burns → sky speaks → parted freed. Dark-ground gleaming-bodied; autumn-sky kept. Rejected: (a) autumn→clear → killed: autumn is season-true. Read aloud: ALL-de-STROY-er … SPOT-less AU-tumn-SKY gleam-ing-BOD-ied — THUS-shown.

reads_against.argmap: Who shows the destroyer? → Darkness-ground shows destroyer by gleaming body.
c1_essence: Egg-middled saps drunk; shown within as-if.
Rosary held turns world within by letters.
Bubbles jar; brow-eye burning taught supreme-fire.
Aimed inward expanding shows unstained self all-states.
Sky-clad speaks bare; veil questioned covering.
Destroyer shown gleaming-bodied from dark ground.
